label: Basic
description: A basic select with a list of options. Best for the minimal pattern: 5 fruits in a sheet that slides up from the field, which shows a prompt until one is picked.

label: Icons
description: Select with icons and a placeholder. Best for app sections such as Dashboard and Security led by muted icons, the chosen one's icon repeated in the field.

label: Grouped Labels
description: Select with grouped options and labels. Best for fruits and vegetables listed under 2 headings of 3 each, the prompt kept out of the list.

label: Large List
description: Select with a large list of options. Best for a 100 row generated list that scrolls inside the sheet; the list is virtualized, so only the rows on screen are drawn.

label: Small Trigger
description: Select with the small field size. Best for the sm size on a 3 fruit list, a shorter control for dense forms and toolbars.

label: Plan Picker
description: Select styled as a plan picker. Best for a plan picker whose field grows to show the chosen plan's name and its one line description.

label: Disabled Item
description: Select with one option disabled. Best for a fruit list where Grapes is shown faded and cannot be picked while the other rows stay open to choice.

label: Field With Label
description: Select with its label and a hint. Best for a Favorite fruit label that names the field for screen readers, with a one sentence hint under it.

label: Invalid
description: Select in an invalid state. Best for a red field with its error message under it, announced to screen readers as it appears.

label: Disabled
description: Select in a disabled state. Best for the entire control switched off and faded, so its sheet of fruits cannot be opened at all.

label: In Dialog
description: Select inside a Dialog. Best for a full width fruit picker inside a dialog with a title and description, opened from a button; its sheet rises over the dialog.

label: Multiple Selection
description: Select with multiple selection. Best for several fruits ticked in one sheet that stays open, the field reading the single name or a count such as 3 fruits selected.

label: Inline With Input
description: Select inline with an input. Best for a narrow status filter of All, Active and Inactive beside a search box in one toolbar row, its label kept for screen readers only.

label: With Button
description: Select with a button side by side. Best for a picker that stretches across a row ending in a Submit button, as a quick one field form.

label: Item Aligned
description: Select opening on the current option. Best for a list whose current fruit is ticked as the sheet opens, so the person sees what they would change.

label: Access Levels
description: Select with access level descriptions. Best for permission levels from Full access to No access, each with a short line on what it allows, the field keeping the name only.

label: Status Bullets
description: Select with colored bullets for status. Best for statuses such as In Progress and Rejected marked by small colored dots in the rows and the field.

label: User Avatars
description: Select with user avatars. Best for a people picker of 10 users with avatars under a heading, the field repeating the chosen person's avatar.

label: Status Badges
description: Select with status badges. Best for a Status: prefix in the field ahead of an outlined colored badge, each row trailed by its own badge.

label: Left Indicator
description: Select with the tick on the left. Best for the check mark moved to the start of each row, its room kept on every row so the labels line up.

label: Clear Button
description: Select with a clear button. Best for an X in the field that empties a controlled framework pick, taking the chevron's place once a value is set.

label: Custom Chevrons
description: Select with an up and down chevron. Best for an up and down chevron pair in place of the stock arrow, swapped for a clearing X when a fruit is chosen.

label: Overlapping Dots
description: Multi-select with overlapping dots. Best for statuses such as Ready, Building and Error, several picked at once and summed up as overlapping dots and a count.

label: Grouped Separators
description: Select with grouped options and separators. Best for frontend and backend tech under 2 headings with a rule between them, from React and Vue to Node.js and Go.

label: Country Flags
description: Country picker select with flag emojis. Best for countries led by their flag emoji in the rows and the field, with United States chosen on load.

label: Status Filter
description: Status filter select with colored dots. Best for a compact filled filter that starts on an All Status row with no dot, above 4 states that each carry one.

label: Option Descriptions
description: Select with description text per option. Best for Startup, Business and Enterprise tiers with a muted line under each, the field keeping the tier name alone.

label: Timezone Offsets
description: Timezone select with UTC offsets. Best for timezone codes grouped by Americas, Europe and Asia, each row trailed by its UTC offset in muted text.

label: Team Assignment
description: Select with avatars for assigning a teammate. Best for an Assign to list of 4 teammates with avatars, the first of them chosen on load.

label: Priority Badges
description: Priority select with colored badges. Best for priority levels from No Priority to Urgent as outline, soft and solid badges in the rows and the field.

label: Font Preview
description: Font family select with a preview. Best for each font option set in its own typeface, Geist, Geist Mono and JetBrains Mono, in the rows and the field.

label: Category Icons
description: Select with icon-labeled categories. Best for file types such as Documents, Images and Archives led by an icon, which stays beside the name in the field.

label: Size Scale
description: Size select with the small field. Best for a 4 step size scale from Small to Extra Large behind the compact sm field.
